item.title: Version 0.1.18
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.18 — accurate goal seed and instant 8-week sparkline on first Strava connect.
Stravas API Agreement § 7.1 limits us to a rolling 7-day cache of raw activities, but explicitly permits storing *derived* weekly aggregates indefinitely. Until now RunBar only used the rolling cache, so a fresh BYO connect saw ~1 week of activities and could not tell an 85 km/week runner from a 19 km/week runner — and the popover sparkline started almost empty.
On a successful Strava connect we now fetch 8 weeks of running history in memory, extract the weekly km/runs/elevation aggregates, and persist only those derived snapshots. Raw activities older than 7 days are never written to disk. Conformant — and the goal seed instantly reflects your actual recent pace.
Side effect: the 8-week sparkline in the popover is fully populated from the first launch instead of having to build up over time.
